title: Prescription Insurance on File Terms: Listing Share for a Coverage Added after Its Effective Date
content:
**Terms.** Under **Prescription Insurance on File**, a coverage the patient listed late earns a listing share on a re-billed cash fill. The delay is the number of calendar days from the coverage's effective date to the day the coverage record was added to the profile.

(a) Where the coverage record was added **14** or more days after its effective date, the charge is multiplied by **0.5**.

(b) Where it was added one to fewer than 14 days after, the charge is multiplied by **0.75**.

(c) Otherwise the charge is multiplied by 1.

The share multiplies the unrounded charge; rounding to the cent is made once, at the end.

## Both sides of each boundary (hypothetical: effective date 1 March)

| Coverage record added on | Days after the effective date | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| 1 March, or earlier | 0 or fewer | 1 |
| 2 March | 1 | 0.75 |
| 14 March | 13 | 0.75 |
| 15 March | 14 | 0.5 |
| 2 April | 32 | 0.5 |

Both dates are read from the coverage record: its effective date and the date it was added.
